title: Row marginal of a product distribution
statement: Let $p$ be a mixed strategy for the row player over $M$ actions and $q$ a mixed strategy for the column player over $N$ actions, and let $\sigma$ be their product distribution, so that $\sigma_{ij} = p_i q_j$ for every profile $(i,j)$. Then for each row action $i$ the row marginal of $\sigma$ equals the corresponding weight of $p$, that is, $\sum_{j} p_i q_j = p_i$.
hypotheses_covered: p is a mixed strategy over M actions
q is a mixed strategy over N actions
sigma is the product distribution of p and q
i is a fixed row action
replaced:
For the product distribution of $p$ and $q$, the row marginal at $i$ equals
$p_i$ (the original row mixed-strategy weight).
